text:
ada: opening coordinated apply for tenant-omega (network + iam + route53). Canary: us-west-1a only. Quiet window 12m. Provider pinned to aws v4.5.0+sha256:1234abcd. please ack if you have live work in tenant-omega.

deploybot: plan started -> https://deploy.logs/infra/tenant-omega/plan/6191234567 :mag:
deploybot: plan summary: 8 changes, 1 replace (aws_route_table_association). risks: DNS record TTL change and IAM permit narrowing.

mohit: ack. I'll review IAM delta for any new wildcard principals.

claire: we have a healthcheck update scheduled in 40m, will pause if this changes route behaviors.

ada-preflight: snapshot check: `aws s3 ls s3://tf-backups/tenant-omega/6191234567.snapshot || exit 1` (hooked to this thread).

sec-oncall: running iam-lint; result webhook will post here.

opsbot: created canary monitor tenant-omega-canary (p50 latency, dns-error-rate). alerts -> #incidents + this thread.

deploybot: preflight apply: `TF_WORKSPACE=tenant-omega TF_VAR_env=prod terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.network -var-file=tenant-omega.prod.tfvars`

ada: starting canary apply in us-west-1a now. DO NOT merge any provider changes while window open.

deploybot: canary apply started 6191234580.

deploybot: canary apply finished 6191234598 — success. route assoc replaced, DNS record updated (TTL lowered).

mohit: iam-lint result: flagged an assumeRole that loosened resource condition. pushing a patch to tighten to specific service account. Recommend hold before full rollout.

ada: holding waves. patch incoming. claire, your healthcheck job stay paused.

claire: pausing now. thanks.

ada: patch pushed; re-running plan.
deploybot: plan re-run complete 6191234608 — shows tightened assumeRole (ok).

ada: re-running canary apply 6191234612.

deploybot: canary apply complete 6191234618 — success. smoke: routes present, dns resolves, instances healthy.

opsbot: metrics green: p50 stable, dns-error-rate 0.02%.

ada: proceeding to full region in two waves: us-west-1b then us-west-1c, 10m stagger. rollback criteria: abort and restore snapshot if dns errors >0.5% for 3m or p50 latency >40% above baseline for 2m. runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/infra/tenant-omega/rollback

mohit: will monitor IAM audit logs for any sts:AssumeRole anomalies.

ada: adding release note to changelog: "tenant-omega: route table assoc update, DNS TTL reduction, IAM assumeRole tightened (canary us-west-1a)" :memo:

claire: will attach plan diffs and canary graphs to the release ticket after waves complete.

ada: thanks team. keeping this thread open for 30m post-rollout. ping here for approvals or immediate rollbacks.
